title: Bring your own AI provider
text: Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and add your API keys. OpenAI and Anthropic are supported. API keys are never sent to the browser bundle and all AI calls route through local server endpoints.
ticks: If AI is not configured, CLI commands return descriptive error messages in JSON format
The HTTP API returns 503 Service Unavailable
The in-editor AI assistant displays a configuration message
aside:
# AI Provider (openai or anthropic)
GREEMO_AI_PROVIDER=openai

# OpenAI Configuration
OPENAI_API_KEY=your_openai_api_key_here
OPENAI_MODEL=gpt-4

# Anthropic Configuration
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your_anthropic_api_key_here

# Optional: API Server Port
GREEMO_API_PORT=3300
